world.description: A two-storey glass house lit from inside at dusk, by a lake.

more.text: Have a look at the view, then try the lights: the switches are by the doors.

start.text: Come in, make yourself at home. The light is best at this hour.

more.text: Everything in here opens: try the drawers and the cupboards.

start.text: Coffee's just made. Help yourself, the mugs are on the counter.

intro.objective: Explode the storeys, cut a section, then walk down to the jetty.
intro.tagline: Warm light, cool water: a glass house the evening the lamps come on.
intro.title: Dusk House by the Lake

world.name: Dusk House by the Lake
